name: web-tablet-real-estate-site-on-orange-fluted-armchair
title: Real-estate site on a tablet resting in an orange ribbed armchair
whatItIs: A tablet leaning in a deeply ribbed orange armchair. The screen shows a dark hero with a palm and modernist building photo, a headline 'Real Estate Decisions Without Guesswork' and small property cards. A logo and studio tag sit in corners.
whatItMeans: Warm and confident; a saturated orange fabric gives a serious dark UI a tactile, luxurious frame.
techniques: Pick a textured, saturated furniture piece as the stage for a dark UI.
Use ribbed lines of the upholstery as a pattern that leads to the screen.
Keep corner labels small so the scene leads.
Photograph at an angle in soft light.

vocabulary.definition: Fabric or leather with vertical ridges.
A scene whose colour contrasts strongly with the UI.
A tablet displaying an interface in a scene.
Small brand labels in frame corners.
